      "name": "tests",

      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests specifically validate consensus rules rather than modifying shared test runner or framework infrastructure."
    },

      "name": "validation",

      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Implements validation rules addressing long-standing consensus vulnerabilities including quadratic legacy sigop exhaustion, timewarp attacks, and CVE-2017-12842 Merkle tree collisions. Proposed consensus soft forks require critical reviewer scrutiny to reach decisions and verify correctness before activation."
